annotation.title_clean: Scenario Compendium for the Legal, Operational and Technical Analysis of Lethal Autonomous Weapon Systems
annotation.title_en: Scenario Compendium for the Legal, Operational and Technical Analysis of Lethal Autonomous Weapon Systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Persi Paoli, G.; Puscas, I.; Afina, Y. (UNIDIR)
annotation.summary_en: UNIDIR publication page for a three-volume compendium of realistic air, land and naval scenarios, in international and non-international armed conflict, for analysing how international humanitarian law applies to lethal autonomous weapon systems. It is a neutral resource for States to support legal analysis, capacity building and confidence building.
key_provisions_or_claims: Presents scenario catalogues across air, land and naval domains for LAWS targeting use
Each scenario includes guiding questions on IHL compliance
Supports structured legal analysis and stress-testing of policies, tactics and rules of engagement
Serves capacity building and confidence building, especially for States with limited modelling capabilities
Offers a common analytical reference to identify convergence and divergence in IHL interpretations
